items.t: Triglycerides above 20 mmol/L: **urgent specialist referral** (NICE NG238); abdominal pain raises concern for **acute pancreatitis**, same-day assessment.
Tendon xanthomas or xanthelasma in a young person: check for **familial hypercholesterolaemia** (NICE CG71).

pearls.t: "**Yellow papules on the buttocks in new diabetes = check triglycerides today — pancreatitis risk.**"
Before starting **isotretinoin, acitretin or oral oestrogen**, check fasting lipids if there are risk factors (family history, obesity, diabetes, alcohol).
